rule_description: Ensure required identifiers and timestamps are present and non-empty.
Affirm that metadata_only is True and raw article text is absent.
Identify and flag duplicate news entries based on item IDs and hashes.
Evaluate publication timestamp against freshness thresholds.
Validate tags against canonical taxonomy registries.
Trace source origin, retrieval mode, and compliance trail.
Benchmark coverage breadth and latency across registered providers.
